name: license-header
description: Adds your license header to every new source file Claude creates.

holder.title: Copyright holder
holder.description: Adds a 'Copyright (c) <year> <holder>' line. Leave empty for the SPDX line alone.

year.title: Copyright year
year.description: Year for the copyright line. Leave empty for the current year.

header.title: Custom header text
header.description: Replaces the generated header. Use \n for line breaks and {license}, {holder}, {year} as placeholders.
